entry.title: New: RES26-243 (Honolulu) — INTRO
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF THREE (3) HIGH-BACK TRADITIONAL BENCHES AND THREE (3) BRONZE PLAQUES WITH INSCRIPTIONS TO READ, “DONATED ON BEHALF OF FOXX WONG AND FRIENDS OF THE WANGWANG FAMILY,” “DONATED BY THE SUPPORTERS OF THE WANGWANG FAMILY,” AND “DONATED BY THE FAMILY OF JIANG MIMI,” VALUED AT $3,841.53, TO THE CITY FROM FOXX WONG TO BE PLACED AT ‘ĀINA MOANA PARK WITHIN ALA MOANA REGIONAL PARK.

Latest action: Introduced.
